title: Refactor VPC telemetry IaC into unified observability module
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Goal: Replace the scattered VPC observability IaC patterns with a single opinionated Terraform module that provisions a full observability stack (Prometheus + Grafana, OpenTelemetry Collector, and a configurable log shipper) for Private/VPC deployments. This module should support safe upgrades (schema and resource changes), automated health checks, canary/rolling rollout hooks, and configurable sinks (S3, vector/Fluent Bit -> observability backend). It must be usable by both Dedicated and Private clusters and integrate with our KMS/IAM patterns.
background: We currently have multiple ad-hoc Terraform modules and Helm charts across teams for telemetry. This causes drift, inconsistent healthchecks, and painful upgrades during Private deployment upgrades. Past incidents (see ENG-623410) highlighted flaky OTEL collector restarts during cluster upgrades and missing dashboard provisioning. A single module will standardize lifecycle, reduce toil, and make upgrades predictable.
acceptance_criteria:
1) terraform module with clearly defined inputs/outputs and versioned release tags.
2) Module provisions Prometheus (metrics, node exporter), Grafana with provisioning for dashboards, an OpenTelemetry collector in Deployment mode with liveness/readiness probes, and a log shipper (Vector or Fluent Bit) with S3/syslog/ELK sinks.
3) Health checks: Prometheus AlertRules for missing scrape targets and high scrape error rate; OTEL collector liveness/readiness probes and metrics-based alert; log shipper error rate alerts.
4) Upgrade plan: documented schema migration steps + automated canary rollout using Terraform workspaces and k8s annotations; a pre-upgrade dry-run checklist.
5) Integration tests in a staging VPC that validate scraping, dashboard provisioning, log delivery to S3, and metric retention.
6) Rollout runbook added to the repo and linked in Console runbooks.
design_decisions:
- Use a single Terraform module with a feature-flag style input map to enable/disable components.
- Default to Vector for log shipping (lower resource usage) but allow Fluent Bit via module variable.
- Collector deployed as Kubernetes Deployment with affinity/anti-affinity to spread replicas.
- Use Helm provider for Grafana provisioning to reuse upstream charts and maintain dashboard provisioning via configmaps.
- Store state in existing remote S3 backend with DynamoDB locking and explicit state migration docs.
- Expose module outputs: grafana_url, prometheus_url, otel_collector_service, log_shipper_status_endpoint.
- Semantic module versioning (major bump for breaking input/output changes).
implementation_notes:
- Module inputs: cidr_blocks, eks_cluster_name, namespace, enable_prometheus, prometheus_scrape_interval, enable_grafana, grafana_admin_user_secret, enable_otlp_collector, collector_replicas, enable_log_shipper, log_shipper_type, s3_sink_bucket, kms_key_id, retention_days.
- Resources: helm_release (grafana), kubernetes_deployment (otel-collector), kubernetes_daemonset/dep (vector/fluentbit), prometheus_operator (CRDs) optional.
- Integrations: IAM roles for nodes to write to S3, KMS CMK usage for bucket encryption, secrets managed via Vault/Kubernetes secret sync.
- Health hooks: pre-apply terraform plan guard rails using tfsec and policy checks; post-apply smoke tests run via github-actions to call /metrics, /health endpoints.
- Provide an outputs file and example root module usage in examples/ for both small staging and large production clusters.
upgrade_strategy:
1) Schema migration tool: a small script that computes planned resource renames and emits a mapping for terraform state mv.
2) Canary: create a new workspace 'canary' that applies module changes to a single observability nodepool/namespace with reduced load. Monitor for 30-60 minutes.
3) Rolling: use k8s rollingUpdate strategy for OTEL collector and vector; ensure PodDisruptionBudgets set.
4) Fallback: automated terraform apply to previous module version if healthchecks fail after defined window.
5) Breaking changes: major module version bump and documented manual migration steps.
6) Automated plan diffs posted to a PR with a human approval gate for any change that recreates >0 critical resources (PVCs, buckets, buckets with encryption changes).
health_checks:
- OTEL collector: /health/live and /health/ready probes; Prometheus scrape target availability metrics (up == 1).
- Prometheus: alert if >10% of scrape targets fail for >2 minutes, and headroom alert if TSDB usage > 75%.
- Grafana: alert if provisioning job fails for >1 deployment or if admin login fails.
- Log shipper: gauge for sink write failures and last successful delivery timestamp; alert on >5m lag for durable sinks.
- Terraform-level: post-apply smoke test (curl prometheus, grafana, otel endpoints).
testing_and_qa:
- Unit: terraform validate + terraform fmt checks in CI.
- Integration: create a staging VPC using examples/ that provisions full stack and runs scripts to push synthetic metrics and logs; assert they arrive in Prometheus and S3.
- Chaos test: simulate node drain during collector rolling update and assert no data loss beyond a single scrape interval.
- Upgrade test: apply from module v1.2 -> v1.3 in staging and validate auto-state-move script.
- Performance: verify collector CPU/RAM at target QPS using load generator; tune replicas and batching settings accordingly.
rollout_plan:
Phase 1 (Canary): apply module in 'canary' workspace to staging namespace in a single region. Run synthetic traffic for 45 minutes and verify health.
Phase 2 (Gradual): expand to 25% of VPCs (by tag). Monitor for 24 hours.
Phase 3 (Full): apply to all VPCs with rolling updates and a 72-hour monitoring window.
Abort criteria: repeated liveness failures, >5% metric loss, or sustained errors in log sink for >15 minutes.
Rollback: terraform apply using previous module version and state-move script where needed.
runbooks_and_documentation:
- Add runbook at docs/observability-module/rollout.md with prechecks, rollback steps, and SLOs.
- Dashboard: create a Console dashboard template for module health including collector_replicas, scrape_error_rate, log_shipper_errors.
- README: example usage and minimal required variables plus migration examples.
- Changelog: maintain CHANGELOG.md in module repo following Keep a Changelog style.
notes_from_review: PM review (Sofia Martinez): prefer Vector default, agreed to keep Fluent Bit opt-in for compatibility.
Security (Ravi Patel): require KMS CMK and set bucket public_access_block = true by default.
Design (Evan Park): add PodDisruptionBudget and nodeSelector configuration for control plane isolation.
